npcs.name: Rook Vell
npcs.description: The fence people recommend when they actually want the job finished.
npcs.biography: Rook Vell's reputation as a fence was built one careful errand at a time around back rooms behind a shuttered tannery. Age 32 sits lightly on this Human, except when old debts creak. Watch long enough and you will see that he never sits with his back to a door. The ledger written in laundry marks is part tool, part talisman. Hunted by Serra; crew with Silk and Jax; rivals Kitty. He would trade sleep to buy legitimacy through a 'respectable' shopfront, yet stays wary of Serra getting a witness who won't scare. Current spark: Claimed ownership of the mill tunnel against Kitty Shade.
npcs.personality: Soft-spoken until principles are poked; never sits with his back to a door.
npcs.motivation: Turn today's scrapes into tomorrow's chance to buy legitimacy through a 'respectable' shopfront.
npcs.secret: Night thoughts keep returning to Serra getting a witness who won't scare, especially since: Claimed ownership of the mill tunnel against Kitty Shade.
npcs.rumor: The ledger written in laundry marks once belonged to a person who vanished upriver.
npcs.voice: Quick river-town diction, then sudden silences that mean more than words.
npcs.appearance: Easy to spot near back rooms behind a shuttered tannery: human, practical layers, and that ledger written in laundry marks.

relationships.note: Building a quiet case against Rook's fence ring.

npcs.name: Silk Mara
npcs.description: Silk holds down market crowds and festival lines with callused competence and open ears.
npcs.biography: Walk into market crowds and festival lines and you will find Silk Mara before you find a free chair. A 29-year-old Half-Elf pickpocket, Silk greets trouble the way other folk greet weather: with a coat and a plan. She apologizes while she steals. The fingerless gloves with silk palms travels with her almost everywhere. Works for Rook; sells extras to Kitty. Her ambition is to exit the life with one perfect score. Her nightmare is Rook deciding she's a liability. Right now, Lifted Lina's note about Lysa's ring and sold the tip to Kitty.
npcs.personality: Warm with regulars, curt with wasters; apologizes while she steals.
npcs.motivation: Secure enough ground to exit the life with one perfect score.
npcs.secret: Quietly arranging matters around: Lifted Lina's note about Lysa's ring and sold the tip to Kitty.
npcs.rumor: Someone paid Silk to forget a name connected to market crowds and festival lines.
npcs.voice: Polite public voice; sharper private asides when trust appears.
npcs.appearance: Looks like someone who sleeps lightly; distinctive detail is the fingerless gloves with silk palms.

npcs.name: Gutter Jax
npcs.description: Gutter holds down rooftops and gutter runs with callused competence and open ears.
npcs.biography: Some townsfolk swear Gutter was born mid-shift at rooftops and gutter runs; the truth is only slightly less devoted. This Human lookout, now 25, treats competence like courtesy. He sleeps with a whistle between his teeth, never far from the chalk for marking safe tiles. Lookout for Rook; spotted by Tomas. Ask what he wants and he names it plainly: be paid enough to stop running messages. Ask what he dreads and the answer is Aya's arrows. Then comes the fresh problem—Signaled Tomas's patrol route to Rook's buyers.
npcs.personality: Warm with regulars, curt with wasters; sleeps with a whistle between his teeth.
npcs.motivation: Secure enough ground to be paid enough to stop running messages.
npcs.secret: Quietly arranging matters around: Signaled Tomas's patrol route to Rook's buyers.
npcs.rumor: Gutter can open doors at rooftops and gutter runs after hours—if asked the right way.
npcs.voice: Polite public voice; sharper private asides when trust appears.
npcs.appearance: Looks like someone who sleeps lightly; distinctive detail is the chalk for marking safe tiles.

npcs.name: Nedda Blacktooth
npcs.description: Familiar face at a low river barge; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: Some townsfolk swear Nedda was born mid-shift at a low river barge; the truth is only slightly less devoted. This Dwarf smuggler, now 90, treats competence like courtesy. She grins with the missing tooth facing customs, never far from the false-bottom grain sacks. Smuggler eyed by Brannic; paid by Orrin. Ask what she wants and she names it plainly: retire upriver with a clean name and dirty fortune. Ask what she dreads and the answer is Brannic measuring her draft again. Then comes the fresh problem—Moved lamp oil under grain manifests with Mael's unknowing help.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; grins with the missing tooth facing customs.
npcs.motivation: Protect her place at a low river barge long enough to retire upriver with a clean name and dirty fortune.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies that moved lamp oil under grain manifests with Mael's unknowing help.
npcs.rumor: Nedda is writing a private list of debts the council will not touch.
npcs.voice: Measured dwarf cadence; concrete nouns before adjectives.
npcs.appearance: Work-worn dwarf garb; false-bottom grain sacks always nearby.

relationships.note: Watches her barge draft at the river gate.

npcs.name: Pale Orin
npcs.description: The forgery clerk people recommend when they actually want the job finished.
npcs.biography: People looking for a reliable forgery clerk are sent to Pale, who claims a tidy upstairs room near the clerk's hall as home ground. At 43, this Human has learned to watch hands before faces. He washes ink from his hands until they crack; neighbors joke that he would miss a coronation before misplacing the set of copied seals in clay. Forger for Rook; nervous around Penna. He is saving courage and coin alike to forge one document that buys him out forever, while trying not to let Penna Ledgerwell recognizing his pen pressure decide the ending. Drafted a fake warehouse writ used in Rook's last shipment.

npcs.name: Kitty Shade
npcs.description: Familiar face at velvet booths and quiet balconies; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: People looking for a reliable information broker are sent to Kitty, who claims velvet booths and quiet balconies as home ground. At 27, this Tiefling has learned to watch hands before faces. She tips well and remembers every favor owed; neighbors joke that she would miss a coronation before misplacing the mirror compact with a poisoned pin unused. Rival to Rook; buys from Silk and Cressida. She is saving courage and coin alike to own the town's secrets market outright, while trying not to let Rook unifying the alleys without her decide the ending. Bought Cressida's Lysa rumor and auctioned a softer version to Edric's enemies.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; tips well and remembers every favor owed.
npcs.motivation: Protect her place at velvet booths and quiet balconies long enough to own the town's secrets market outright.

npcs.name: Bask Hammer
npcs.description: Familiar face at doorways of debtors; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: Some townsfolk swear Bask was born mid-shift at doorways of debtors; the truth is only slightly less devoted. This Half-Orc debt collector, now 35, treats competence like courtesy. He knocks politely, then harder, never far from the leather gloves lined with coin weights. Marrow's collector; clashed with Dorn. Ask what he wants and he names it plainly: earn Marrow's partnership, not just wages. Ask what he dreads and the answer is Dorn catching him in public again. Then comes the fresh problem—Warned a baker that 'accidents' happen to ovens behind on interest.

npcs.name: Mouse Pip
npcs.description: A sewer runner rooted at sewer mouths and grate shadows, known for how he apologizes to rats before he traps them.
npcs.biography: Mouse Pip's reputation as a sewer runner was built one careful errand at a time around sewer mouths and grate shadows. Age 21 sits lightly on this Halfling, except when old debts creak. Watch long enough and you will see that he apologizes to rats before he traps them. The oilskin map folio of tunnels is part tool, part talisman. Knows sewers; fed by Pola; tracked by Kessa. He would trade sleep to sell his maps to someone who won't kill him after, yet stays wary of being sealed in below during a storm. Current spark: His tunnel sketch matches Wren's joke map and Rina's overheard 'mill tunnel'.
npcs.personality: Steady and sharp-eyed; apologizes to rats before he traps them.
npcs.motivation: To sell his maps to someone who won't kill him after without feeding being sealed in below during a storm.
npcs.secret: Knows more about this than he admits: His tunnel sketch matches Wren's joke map and Rina's overheard 'mill tunnel'.
npcs.rumor: A smugglers' mark was seen near sewer mouths and grate shadows on a night Mouse worked late.
npcs.voice: Low and practical, with a habit of repeating the important clause once.
npcs.appearance: A halfling silhouette framed by sewer mouths and grate shadows, hands seldom empty of the oilskin map folio of tunnels.
